**Finding: deviation (high) — § 12.1 License**

The grant fails the LICENSE rule on two of three parameters:

- **Revocable at will.** "nonexclusive, **revocable** license" with no standard or trigger — IBM could withdraw our right to use the Base Components unilaterally, even while we continue paying for Services.
- **Affiliates and contractors excluded.** The grant runs to "Customer" only, and § 14.17 (Limitation of Licenses) forecloses any implied extension. Our Affiliates are a defined term (preamble ¶ b) and are used elsewhere (§ 9.2), so scoping them in is consistent with the rest of the bargain. § 14.11 (no resale) remains intact, so this is internal-use scope only, not resale.
- **Successor transfer — already satisfied.** § 14.10 permits assignment to a successor by merger, consolidation or acquisition, so no edit was needed there.

**Redline (validated, ok:true):** extend the grant to "Customer, its Affiliates and its contractors acting on Customer's behalf," delete "revocable," and tie any revocation to expiration or termination under Section 3.

Fallback offered in the comment: affiliate coverage on written notice, if IBM resists automatic extension.
